run_http2_test_servers: run the HTTP2 test servers on incrementing ports starting from a configurable base port
start_test_servers: start one HTTP2 test server per test case on incrementing port numbers beginning with base_port
create_H2Factory: create an H2Factory instance that builds HTTP2 protocol handlers for a given test case
listen_endpoint: listen on a TCP endpoint with an H2Factory and handle listen errors by stopping the reactor
parse_arguments: parse command line arguments to get the base port for running HTTP2 test servers
